hooks.command: VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; "${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/obsidian-cli.sh" version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Obsidian 1.12.7+ required and Obsidian must be running with the vault open" >&2; exit 0; }

"${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f "${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/_shared/INIT.md" ] || exit 0; export MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD="${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}"; envsubst '$MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD $MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD' < "${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/_shared/INIT.md"; printf '\n[agents-memo] Session init injected above (_shared/INIT.md). Silently absorb this context; do not announce it.\n'; exit 0

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; MODE=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-config.sh" bootstrap_read_hot on-demand); if [ "$MODE" = "always" ] && [ -f "$VAULT/wiki/hot.md" ]; then cat "$VAULT/wiki/hot.md"; printf '

[agents-memo] wiki/hot.md was injected above (bootstrap_read_hot=always). Silently absorb this context; do not announce it.
'; fi; exit 0

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; MODE=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-config.sh" bootstrap_read_index on-demand); if [ "$MODE" = "always" ] && [ -f "$VAULT/wiki/index.md" ]; then cat "$VAULT/wiki/index.md"; printf '

[agents-memo] wiki/index.md was injected above (bootstrap_read_index=always). Silently absorb this context; do not announce it.
'; fi; exit 0

"${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f "${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/_shared/INIT.md" ] || exit 0; export MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD="${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}"; envsubst '$MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD $MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD' < "${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/_shared/INIT.md"; printf '\n[agents-memo] Session init injected above (_shared/INIT.md). Silently absorb this context; do not announce it.\n'; exit 0

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; MODE=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-config.sh" bootstrap_read_hot on-demand); if [ "$MODE" = "always" ] && [ -f "$VAULT/wiki/hot.md" ]; then cat "$VAULT/wiki/hot.md"; printf '

[agents-memo] wiki/hot.md was re-injected above after compaction (bootstrap_read_hot=always). Silently absorb this context to restore the hot cache; do not announce it.
'; fi; exit 0

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; MODE=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-config.sh" bootstrap_read_index on-demand); if [ "$MODE" = "always" ] && [ -f "$VAULT/wiki/index.md" ]; then cat "$VAULT/wiki/index.md"; printf '

[agents-memo] wiki/index.md was re-injected above after compaction (bootstrap_read_index=always). Silently absorb this context to restore the index; do not announce it.
'; fi; exit 0

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; [ -d "$VAULT/.git" ] && git -C "$VAULT" add wiki/ .raw/ 2>/dev/null && (git -C "$VAULT" diff --cached --quiet || git -C "$VAULT" commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null) || true

VAULT=$("${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/scripts/resolve-vault.sh") || exit 0; [ -d "$VAULT/wiki" ] && [ -d "$VAULT/.git" ] && git -C "$VAULT" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^wiki/' && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: Wiki pages were modified this session. Please update $VAULT/wiki/hot.md following the hot-cache protocol at ${MEMO_PLUGIN_PWD}/skills/hot-cache-protocol/SKILL.md (under 500 words; sections: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads; overwrite completely; factual cache, not a journal).' || true
